$comment: Motion A v3. NO TAXONOMY NODE, deliberately: this motion is category-agnostic — the product in question comes from the partner's own book (`partner_accounts.target_product`), not from a taxonomy branch. Binding it to `infrastructure-automation` also HIJACKED the pre-existing Motion Designer, whose query takes the highest active version on a node: Motion A outranked the modernization play it depends on. Whitespace is never inferred from absence: `partner_accounts.installed` is NOT NULL DEFAULT false and written from the presence of a CSV column, so false means 'nobody told us'. Coverage is what the book establishes; product-absence must be stated as evidence with polarity -1.
name: Install-Base / Whitespace Expansion
objective: Validate and advance an expansion opportunity with the partner on an account they already cover.

Which expansion use case the account would actually buy.

measurementAssociations: An opportunity opened on this account after application — association only, never attribution.
Evidence added that establishes install-base state, which would close the largest gap.
